notes: Upstream-clone bugfix in google/guava (v4.3 family): the edge-set of an undirected graph built with the GraphBuilder API violates the java.util.Collection contract - edges().contains(EndpointPair.ordered(a,b)) returns true for an edge put as unordered, while NO element of the set equals that ordered pair (verified at parent 7731825df: 'contains=true anyMatch=false'). Localised by reading AbstractBaseGraph.validateEndpoints/isOrderingCompatible and AbstractNetwork.isOrderingCompatible, both of which read 'endpoints.isOrdered() || !this.isDirected()' and therefore accept ordered EndpointPairs on undirected graphs (and GraphConstants.ENDPOINTS_MISMATCH carries the old directed-only message text). Upstream fix (76260d9b) inverts the check to 'endpoints.isOrdered() == this.isDirected()' so an undirected graph rejects ordered pairs symmetrically; git fix commit itself changed 3 guava/src source files + 4 guava-tests graph test files + mirror copies under android/. The agent sees the real tree at the parent commit (single depth-1 object store, fix commit provably unreachable, HEAD pinned), must author its own failing reproduction (/app/repro.sh, executed against a fresh compile of the repaired tree and against a pristine pre-fix classes dir baked at /opt/prefix/classes) before fixing, then localise and fix the source. Verifier: provenance (HEAD == parent, fix commit unreachable, blob-level scope check permitting only the 3 guava/src graph files + their android mirrors to differ), a fresh javac rebuild of guava/src + guava-testlib + the graph test directory from the agent's tree (kills planted artifacts and executes the real deliverable), the agent's repro in both directions, the 7 upstream regression test methods extracted from the fix commit at image build time into /opt/golden (endpointPair_undirected_contains, hasEdgeConnecting_undirected_mismatch, edgeValueOrDefault_undirected_mismatch, putEdgeValue_undirected_orderMismatch, hasEdgeConnecting_mismatch, edgesConnecting_orderMismatch, edgeConnectingOrNull_orderMismatch - run both method-by-method with an authored RunOne JUnit helper and as whole classes), the project's own existing graph test suite (21 JUnit classes: EndpointPairTest, ValueGraphTest, GraphEquivalenceTest, NetworkEquivalenceTest, GraphsTest, GraphPropertiesTest, GraphMutationTest, NetworkMutationTest, ElementOrderTest, MapCacheTest, TraverserTest, StandardMutable{Directed,Undirected}{Graph,Network}Test, StandardImmutable{Directed,Undirected}GraphTest, ImmutableNetworkTest, ImmutableValueGraphTest, StandardImmutableGraphAdditionalTest, DefaultNetworkImplementationsTest), and three authored hidden cases with inputs the upstream test does not use (string-node ValueGraph with values, Network with explicit edge objects through the AbstractNetwork code path, ImmutableGraph plus a directed-graph regression check). Dependency pins: openjdk-21-jdk-headless; error_prone_annotations 2.11.0 (the tree's own pom pin; the mined 2.10.0 pin lacks com.google.errorprone.annotations.Keep which guava-testlib imports); checker-qual 2.5.0, j2objc-annotations 1.3, jsr305 3.0.2, animal-sniffer-annotations 1.18, failureaccess 1.0.1, junit 4.13.2, hamcrest-core 1.3, truth 1.1.3, truth-java8-extension 1.1.3. No class-file bytes of the fixed tree are ever baked into the image: the fixed tree exists only transiently in throwaway probe containers and the throwaway golden-extraction clone; /opt/golden holds only upstream test source, never the fix. Compute at 1 CPU: whole guava/src javac ~7s, image build ~45s, verifier ~90s.
